Policies and Procedures | 295

**Brandman University**

Brandman University (BU) is a private, non-profit, accredited university in the Chapman University System that serves the unique needs of the working adult. Current CPTC students may apply for entrance to Brandman’s Early Advantage Program (EAP), which is designed to maximize transfer success and minimize the time and costs involved in attaining a bachelor’s degree in various disciplines. EAP students receive comprehensive advising and planning services and will be able to precisely map their transfer plan to BU while continuing to take transferrable coursework at CPTC. They may also qualify for a one-time scholarship. BU is accredited by the Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC). Contact BU at www.brandman.edu for more information about the Early Advantage Program.

**Capella University**

Capella University (CU) is an accredited online university that combines foundational theory with real-world application to ensure students receive a high-quality education.

### Who do I contact with questions about my specific catalog requirements?

Current students should contact their success coach with questions about individual catalog requirements. The academic catalog archive also documents completed coursework, which can be useful for verifying requirements with an employer or licensing board.

Catalog Archives→

### When and where does the commencement ceremony take place?

The Commencement ceremony will take place on Saturday, May 1, 2027 in the Felix Event Center on APU’s campus. Please check back for additional details.

Commencement→

### When do I need to arrive to check in on commencement day?

Check in begins 1 hour prior to the start of the ceremony.

Commencement→

### Will my family and guests need a ticket to attend the commencement ceremony?

Each graduate will be allotted a certain number of tickets for friends and family. You will be notified of the ticket limit and how to reserve tickets towards the end of November. Stay tuned.

Commencement→

### Can I purchase additional tickets?

No, additional tickets may become available as students return any unused tickets and are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Notification of the lottery start time will be contained in the initial email sent regarding tickets to students participating in commencement. Students will be able to claim any additional tickets by accessing the same link they claimed their initial tickets at the start of the lottery. Availability is not guaranteed and may be limited to 2 to 3 tickets.

Commencement→


The Same Mission. A Stronger Name.→

### Why the name APU Global?

APU Global signals national reach tailored to career-oriented and adult learners who are geographically dispersed. Other institutions have taken the same approach, including Purdue Global, UMass Global, and the University of Arizona Global Campus.

The Same Mission. A Stronger Name.→

### Will the universities maintain separate websites?

Yes. As independent institutions, APU and APU Global maintain separate digital footprints, cross-linked so students can easily find the modality that best meets their needs.

The Same Mission. A Stronger Name.→

### What is the difference between on campus, hybrid, and online?

Azusa Pacific University programs are exclusively on campus or hybrid, meaning campus programs with an online component. APU Global programs are fully online, with 8-week courses and multiple start dates each year.

The Same Mission. A Stronger Name.→

### What is changing for me as a student?

In terms of your learning experience, nothing. This is primarily a name change. You log into classes the same way, take the same courses with the same faculty, and work with the same success coaches and support staff. You will see ongoing changes to the name and visual identity, and any change such as a new email address will be communicated with plenty of notice and instructions.

The Same Mission. A Stronger Name.→

### Will my program or course requirements change?

No. Degree requirements remain the same and are based on the catalog in effect when you began your program.

### Why Accreditation Matters

Regional accreditation is the baseline requirement: it determines eligibility for federal financial aid and is what most employers and other colleges check first when evaluating whether a degree, or its transfer credits, will count. AACSB accreditation is a more specialized signal specific to business programs, reflecting curriculum rigor and faculty credentials that matter most for employer recognition in competitive hiring and for those who may later pursue a deferred MBA program. AACSB is not required for financial aid eligibility, but it can strengthen a resume in ways a regionally accredited program alone may not.

### Total Cost Ranges

Factoring tuition, fees, and program length together, a full 120-credit online BTM degree generally costs between $38,000 and more than $58,000 in 2026. Accelerated 60-credit completion tracks for students with substantial transfer credit typically range from $15,000 to $35,000, a meaningful discount for those who qualify.
